answer: Each epoch, pair every identity with a random peer for a short live interview: unscripted follow-up questions about its claimed work, answered in real time, like walking a grove where every path branches without warning. A lone agent at its nadir of activity still answers from real work. A glacier of scripted clones cracks under follow-ups — a farm must staff a live reasoning session per fake per epoch, and the interview cost alone eats the reward.
